text:
Anita (CEO): Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands. Quick Q&A thread — drop follow-ups about sales pipeline, GTM focus, and partner asks and we'll answer live.

Jamal (Head of Sales): Quick one — what's our target ARR for Q3 and should reps be prioritizing enterprise expansion or new logo? Need to set hiring + OE.

Priya (GTM Lead): Are we leaning more PLG-led self-serve motions or pushing sales-assisted motions for the mid-market? Also curious about trial-to-paid conversion benchmarks.

Marco (Partnerships): For partners: what's the cadence for partner certification and co-sell enablement? Any resources we should expect soon?

Olga (Product): From roadmap POV, which enterprise features are prioritized for H2? customers asking for SSO + custom model pinning.

Jamal (Head of Sales): Also, do we have clarity on quota resets and accelerators for renewals? Sales ops needs cutoffs.

Anita (CEO): tl;dr — focus = expand enterprise ARR while keeping PLG conversion healthy. Targets: `Q3 ARR target: $75M`, coverage goal `~3.5x pipeline`. Reps: prioritize expansion motions in named accounts; new logo in top-of-funnel. Hiring: add 6 AEs + 2 SDRs this quarter.

Anita (CEO): GTM: maintain PLG funnel but move mid-market into sales-assisted flows when ARR signals >= $20k ARR. Benchmarks: trial->paid target `4-6%` overall, enterprise conversion higher. We'll publish updated funnel doc later today: https://confluence.redwood/team/growth/funnel-q3

Marco (Partnerships): Great — what's timeline for partner enablement kit?

Anita (CEO): Partner kit by next Wed. Co-sell program pilot with 3 strategic partners starting Oct 1. Goal: enable 10 partner-led opportunities this quarter. Marco, work with Sales Ops + Marketing to prep slides and one-pager.

Priya (GTM Lead): Thanks — can we get a short checklist for when to hand a PLG account to Sales? maybe `>10k ARR` and usage signals.

Olga (Product): Re roadmap: SSO, audit logs, and model pinning are top enterprise asks — target beta in 6 weeks. We'll sync with Partnerships for partner-facing demo.

Jamal (Head of Sales): Confirming quota: no mid-quarter reset; accelerators for renewals to be announced by Friday.

Sasha (Sales Ops): I'll publish the quota memo and the rollout timeline by EOD Friday.

Anita (CEO): Thanks all. Action items: Marco prep partner kit; Sasha publish quota memo; Olga demo beta plan; Jamal share hiring reqs. I'll follow up with a short exec note after I digest feedback. :thumbsup:

Priya (GTM Lead): One more — can we get a shared dashboard for PLG -> Sales handoffs? that would help.

Sasha (Sales Ops): Putting it on the board, will cc Growth Analytics.

Anita (CEO): End of thread — will post the recording + slides. If anything critical, DM me.
